official_definition: Once per turn, you can send two cores from your Counter Area/Spirits to this Spirit. When you've done so, this Spirit can refresh, and you can destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the highest BP and an opposing Nexus.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Dragon Awaken] or [Dragon Awaken: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Dragon Awaken]", "give [Dragon Awaken]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Transitions state from EXHAUSTED to REFRESHED.
